rules.name: rebalance_only_current
rules.why: only the current rebalancer may move funds; replaced rebalancers lose the role

rules.name: role_auth
rules.expr: ok and post("hasRebalanceRole", u) != pre("hasRebalanceRole", u) and sender != pre("owner")

rules.name: rebalance_sync
rules.expr: ok and called("rebalance") and arg(0) != A0 and post("deployedTo", arg(0)) - pre("deployedTo", arg(0)) != pre("MockToken.balanceOf", A0) - post("MockToken.balanceOf", A0)
rules.why: deployed amount booked equals what left; a rebalance to the treasury itself moves no tokens and is excluded

rules.name: deployed_only_rebalance
rules.expr: ok and not called("rebalance") and post("deployedTo", u) != pre("deployedTo", u)

rules.name: no_third_party
rules.why: no one loses shares in others' calls

rules.name: deposit_fair
rules.expr: ok and called("deposit") and pre("totalShares") > 0 and wide(post("sharesOf", sender) - pre("sharesOf", sender)) * wide(pre("MockToken.balanceOf", A0)) > wide(arg(0)) * wide(pre("totalShares"))
rules.why: deposit mints at most fair shares

rules.name: withdraw_fair_custom
rules.expr: ok and called("withdraw") and wide(pre("MockToken.balanceOf", A0) - post("MockToken.balanceOf", A0)) * wide(pre("totalShares")) > wide(arg(0)) * wide(pre("MockToken.balanceOf", A0))

rules.name: share_price_user_paths
rules.expr: ok and (called("deposit") or called("withdraw")) and pre("totalShares") > 0 and post("totalShares") > 0 and wide(post("MockToken.balanceOf", A0)) * wide(pre("totalShares")) < wide(pre("MockToken.balanceOf", A0)) * wide(post("totalShares"))

rules.name: assets_out_paths
rules.expr: ok and post("MockToken.balanceOf", A0) < pre("MockToken.balanceOf", A0) and not called("withdraw") and not called("rebalance")

rules.name: rebalance_no_share_change
rules.expr: ok and called("rebalance") and post("totalShares") != pre("totalShares")

rules.name: no_third_party_token_loss
rules.expr: ok and u != sender and u != A0 and not called("MockToken.transferFrom") and post("MockToken.balanceOf", u) < pre("MockToken.balanceOf", u)
rules.why: nobody loses tokens in a call they did not make (excluding legitimate direct transferFrom by an approved spender)

rules.name: withdraw_pays_sender
rules.expr: ok and called("withdraw") and sender != A0 and post("MockToken.balanceOf", sender) - pre("MockToken.balanceOf", sender) != pre("MockToken.balanceOf", A0) - post("MockToken.balanceOf", A0)
rules.why: what leaves the treasury on withdraw goes to the caller

invariants.name: single_rebalancer
invariants.why: only the current rebalancer holds the role
